title: 亞洲大學行政大樓暨圖書館
scope: Historical source-composite exterior, primarily 2008–2011 images plus undated aerial and later one-wing guide plans. Not as-built or verified 2026 condition.
architect_credit: Not established; do not attribute this building to the architect of the separate modern museum.

sources.title: Asia University official garden-side rear photograph
sources.chronology: EXIF DateTimeOriginal 2008-07-25; metadata is not independent capture authentication.
sources.observed: Straight broad brick rear, cream grid/base, dome/drum and modest central entry projection.
sources.limitations: Trees hide portions of lower rear. Counts and dimensions not measured.

sources.title: Asia University official front-oblique photograph
sources.observed: Shallow concave cream colonnade, broad stairs, inset end towers, tall central green dome.
sources.limitations: Copyright string present; no source pixels/textures redistributed. No repair-era inference.
